pawns.name: Dagny
pawns.note: recruited from the Brackwater Corsairs, whom she betrayed

activePlots.summary: Dagny betrayed the Brackwater Corsairs when she joined. The colony freed a Corsair prisoner, Teague Holt, on day 370; he left saying the Corsairs would remember the kindness, or the betrayal.
